errors.id: That is not a valid record.
errors.file: That picture was not recognized; choose it again.
errors.choice: Choose one of the offered values.
errors.tag: There is no tag with that name.

reactions.heading: Reactions
reactions.subtitle: The reactions members can leave under a post, in the order they are offered.

list.heading: Reaction types
list.description: Offered in this order. A type cannot be deleted, only stopped from being offered.
list.emptyDescription: Members have nothing to react with until a type is added.
list.animated: Animated, {count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}}
list.forums: In {count, plural, one {# forum} other {# forums}}
list.deactivateWarning: Members will no longer be offered this reaction. Reactions already given stay on the posts.
list.activateWarning: Members will be offered this reaction again.

form.basicsHelp: What members see on the reaction button.
form.emojiHelp: The character shown on the button, and wherever a picture cannot be shown.
form.title: Label
form.pictureHelp: Optional. A PNG or WebP image shown instead of the emoji. For an animation, upload a sprite sheet and cut it into frames under Animation.
form.scoreHelp: Positive, zero or negative, such as +1, 0 or -1.
form.scoreDefaultHelp: Positive, zero or negative, such as +1, 0 or -1. Leave empty to use the forum's default score.
form.positionHelp: Where it is offered, lowest first. The order can be changed later with Sort.
form.frameWidthHelp: For a sprite sheet: the width of one frame, in pixels. Leave both sizes empty to show the whole picture.
form.frameHeightHelp: The height of one frame, in pixels.
form.frameCountHelp: How many frames to play, read left to right, then top to bottom. Leave empty for one.

access.forumsHelp: Leave it empty to allow the reaction everywhere. Otherwise it can be given only on posts in the forums chosen (not in their subforums), and never on wall posts, comments or conversations.
access.lockedShow: See it greyed out, with a hint
access.lockedHelp: Applies to the rule above. A reaction already given stays on the post whichever you choose.

create.heading: New reaction type
create.description: A reaction type cannot be deleted, only stopped from being offered.

edit.heading: Edit reaction type
edit.description: A new score applies to new reactions only; reactions already given keep theirs.

sort.heading: Sort reaction types
sort.description: Members are offered the types in this order, first to last.

wordFilters.heading: Word filters
wordFilters.subtitle: Words that are replaced or sent for moderation when a member posts them.

list.heading: Filters
list.description: What happens to a post is decided by the backend when it is posted.
list.emptyDescription: Nothing is replaced or held back by word.
list.removeWarning: The word will no longer be replaced or held back. Posts already made are not changed.

create.heading: New filter
create.description: Adding a term that already has a filter changes that filter.
create.termHelp: The word or phrase to look for. It cannot be renamed later.
create.actionHelp: Replace swaps the word for the replacement; hold sends the post to the moderation queue.
create.replacementHelp: Used when the action is to replace the word.

edit.heading: Edit word filter
edit.description: Change what happens to a post that holds the word.
edit.termHelp: The word cannot be renamed. Remove the filter and add a new one to change it.

tags.heading: Tags
tags.subtitle: The tags members put on threads and the hashtags they type in opening posts. Rename, merge or delete them here.

list.heading: Tags
list.description: By name. A renamed or merged tag still answers to its old names, so links and hashtags already written keep working.
list.emptyDescription: Tags appear when members use them.
list.deleteWarning: {count, plural, one {The tag is taken off its thread.} other {The tag is taken off its # threads.}} Hashtags already written stay as links to a page that no longer exists.

edit.heading: Edit tag
edit.description: Rename the tag, merge it into another or delete it.
edit.name: Name
edit.renameDescription: The old name stays as an alias, so links and hashtags already written keep working.
edit.mergeDescription: The threads of this tag move to the other one, and this tag's name and aliases become aliases of it. The tag is then removed.
edit.intoHelp: The name of the other tag, with or without the #.

pages.heading: Pages
pages.subtitle: The text pages the site publishes about itself: terms, privacy, contact.

wellKnown.terms: The registration form links to this page as its terms. Members accept it when its version changes.
wellKnown.privacy: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.legal: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.contact: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.cookies: The words of the cookie policy page. The table of cookies under it is built by the site.
wellKnown.upgrade-faq: Shown on the upgrade page as its questions and answers.
wellKnown.rules: The registration form links to this page as the rules. Members accept it when its version changes.

suggestions.heading: Pages the site expects
suggestions.description: The site links to or reads these pages. They do not exist yet.

create.heading: New page
create.description: The slug is part of the page's address and cannot be changed afterwards.
create.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. The page is served at /pages/ followed by the slug.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHelp: BB code: [B]bold[/B], [I]italic[/I], [U]underline[/U], [URL=https://example.com]link[/URL], [QUOTE]quote[/QUOTE], [LIST][*]item[/LIST], [CODE]code[/CODE]. It is rendered by the site when you save, and the text is kept exactly as written here.
fields.publishedHelp: A page that is not published is visible to administrators only.
fields.newVersionHelp: Leave this off for a corrected typo. Switch it on when the text changes in a way members must accept again.
fields.newVersionSwitch: Publish as a new version: everyone must accept it again before they can post, react or message

pageEdit.heading: Edit page
pageEdit.subtitle: The BB code source of a page. Save, then open the public page to see it rendered.

wellKnown.terms: The registration form links to this page as its terms. Members accept it when its version changes.
wellKnown.privacy: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.legal: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.contact: Has its own address on the site.
wellKnown.cookies: The words of the cookie policy page. The table of cookies under it is built by the site.
wellKnown.upgrade-faq: Shown on the upgrade page as its questions and answers.
wellKnown.rules: The registration form links to this page as the rules. Members accept it when its version changes.

public.heading: On the site
public.preview: Open the address to see the page as members read it, after saving.
public.hidden: This page is not published, so the address is not available to members.

form.heading: Page
form.description: Changes appear on the site when you save.

delete.heading: Delete page
delete.warning: The page is deleted and its address stops working. Navigation entries that point at it are left alone.
